svg.title: One visual question, four analytical paths
svg.desc: A human works entirely in the Embedding Atlas interface, one agent mixes interface and code, another computes entirely off screen, and a third agent substitutes prior knowledge after app inspection fails. All produce plausible conclusions, but their evidence differs in visibility and faithfulness.
svg.text: One visual question, four analytical paths
The conclusions sound compatible. What differs is how—and whether—the analyst can inspect their evidentiary basis.
What characterizes the wines rated above 95 points?

g.aria-label: Human action steps one through three

svg.text: Agent-only routes can expose data and computation—or replace missing evidence with unverified prior knowledge.
SAME TASK · PLAUSIBLE CLAIMS · UNEQUAL VISIBILITY
Can the analyst see and trust how each claim was produced?
Schematic synthesis of representative WebVA trajectories · Embedding Atlas wine-review task
